state: registered prospective experiment; approved for publication; no diagnostic performance observations acquired
purpose: Distinguish native stream transport overhead using actual pinned Chromium; component diagnostic only, no full-import, memory, PR or speedup qualification.

C.meaning: same native guards/chunk math/error retry, direct writer transport

identities.browserLock: Source preparation checks exact playwright-core/browsers.json bytes and hash across all three real dependency directories; the actual Chromium version must match the pinned metadata.
identities.sourceBoundary: Only parser runtime and candidate unit tests may differ between product trees. Research harness/canary identities are recorded separately; timed workers import unmodified runtime.

grouping.source: Capture actual baseline three-worker production lazy planner in a separate untimed Chrome preflight; observe worker parse messages without altering payloads or scheduling.
grouping.validation: Preflight must reproduce the frozen ordered bank membership exactly, all53banks once, and528299rows. No custom partition algorithm substitutes for the production planner.

correctnessPreflight.canary: Run the unchanged original native gzip canary SHA2566308397a9c7d7c6e05bdc8cacbb77c9b5129d87db43fcc28c56ea5b3901752e8 on A versus C under actual Chrome before timing. B already has exact-head hosted green canary; full-corpus admission is rechecked for all3.
correctnessPreflight.nativeAdmission: One complete untimed corpus pass in each of A/B/C, after one initial first-group inflate solely to initialize the real decoder and install the WASM counter. The initial group warms the native capability cache before counts reset. A must report 0 native/12 WASM calls; B/C must report 53 native/0 WASM calls. No counter wrappers exist in measured workers.
correctnessPreflight.parity: Framed logical joined source bytes and bank spans/counts/lengths; all rows score/sequence/reading relation, every row encoded content including tags/rules with length/two-hash metadata, exact relative metadata/unique-index/unique-row/unique-signature maps, logical slab ranges and flags, every record/index key/string plan and index binary/route bytes. Absolute WASM addresses and unreferenced heap bytes are excluded.
correctnessPreflight.failurePolicy: Stop on the first fixture, source, canary, admission, parity or observation error. Preserve all completed and failed records without replacement. Handled worker errors return completed passes/groups and the current partial group/stage. Persist each preflight/observation ID before launch; timeout or worker-process failure retains that active ID. Incomplete observations never enter statistics.

measurement.host: One isolated GitHub-hosted job, no concurrent benchmark process from this workflow.
measurement.launch: Fresh Chromium process and fresh real dedicated module worker per observation, launched serially; COOP same-origin/COEP require-corp, require crossOriginIsolated and SharedArrayBuffer/sharedWASM.
measurement.compilation: Module fetch, WASM compile/instantiation, ZIP reads and compressed-input transfer are outside all timers.
measurement.retention: Keep only resident compressed corpus and one decoded/source/result group. No whole decoded corpus or complete output retention.
measurement.warmupUnit: Two excluded complete 53-bank, 12-group passes in each measured observation worker, with the same validation and natural reference release policy as the measured pass. Untimed admission workers instead use the separately specified one-pass probe.
measurement.primaryTimer: Sum worker performance.now intervals around inflateCompressedTermBankSourcesWasm for all12groups, including complete source CRC validation and native stream completion.
measurement.secondaryTimer: Parse and completed lookup construction timed separately after logical source hashing; report separately and as sum of measured components, never as a contiguous import time.
measurement.outsideTimers: Source digest/spans, complete framed output projection hashing, fixture I/O, startup/compilation and result serialization. Verification is the same per-group policy for every arm; it may influence subsequent GC, which is not forcibly removed.
measurement.instrumentation: Timed workers do not wrap DecompressionStream/WASM functions or attach inspector/tracing; activation counters belong to separate untimed preflight workers.
measurement.options: Production JMdict semantic options/version3: validateGlossaryTypes=true; emitContentSlab, computeContentHashes, token binary content, prepared lookup and route=true; media flags=false; singleChunk=true, maxPendingChunks=1, compactContentMetadata=true. Secondary component covers parse, lookup and route construction; it excludes worker result copying, ownership transfer, compression and storage.
measurement.gcPolicy: No forced GC, inspector or memory sampler in any timed observation. Identical per-group digest/parity work remains outside timers; release references naturally. Native allocation, reclamation and retention costs remain in the fresh-browser worker lifecycle. No separate post-pass GC probe in this fixed budget.

comparisons: B/A reproduction of current native mechanism
statistics: Retain every group and arm; six complete paired ratios per runtime comparison, paired median, equal-work ratio, faster count, and descriptive bootstrap of 10000 complete-pair resamples using Python random.Random(897) and sorted indices 249/9749 exactly as the existing qualification reader. Retain both identical-code controls. Never pool hosts or select/remove tails.
decision: This can justify considering a new full-import experiment only if the mechanism improvement is clear relative to controls and correctness passes. It cannot qualify a PR, excuse the existing JMdict memory failure, or change frozen old results.

supersedesProspectiveDraft.reason: Final source identities, independent projection review, complete failure retention, and one untimed admission pass per arm are registered before acquisition. The22-observation schedule and no-forced-GC policy are unchanged.

rootReview: Source guards, fixed schedule, no-forced-GC timers, correctness gates and revised partial-failure retention approved before publication.

beforeTiming: Exact source runtime and changed-unit ESLint
Exactly 46 focused tests across native-inflate and source-CRC files
Full-corpus source, semantic and native-admission preflight
gatePolicy.failure: Stop before timing if any gate fails; always upload source identities, plan, logs and failure evidence. This job cannot qualify a PR.

independentReview.scope: Exact worker projection and source/metadata/lookup lifetimes; real baseline WASM Node projection smoke only. All embedded timings discarded. No browser, native-path activation or performance evidence.
independentReview.staticConclusion: No remaining material blocker; unique signatures and logical range/metadata omissions were corrected before acquisition.
